text:
packet-20 - unverified image-only reading
==========================================

Exposure statement: No proposed identification of this text reached me before
reading. The images themselves carry modern pencil shelfmarks ("Stams, STA,
Frg. 226-1r / 1v / 2r / 2v"), which I report as visible content only. I did not
search, consult editions, or read packet.json.

Beyond the stated rules: to read reversed/inverted text I made rotated and
mirrored copies of image-017, image-019 and image-020 with `sips` in my session
scratchpad (no other files opened). Several images (001-011) were dropped from my
context once by a request limit and re-opened; image-004 to image-011, image-013
to image-015, image-021, image-040, image-042 and image-044 could not all be
re-examined at full attention; see Limitations.

LAYOUT SURVEY (observations)
----------------------------
- Four overviews: image-001 (face "226-1r"), image-012 ("226-1v"), image-023
  ("226-2r"), image-034 ("226-2v"). Tiles: 002-011 for 1r, 013-022 for 1v,
  024-033 for 2r, 035-044 for 2v.
- Each piece is a long vertical strip of parchment from a single-column
  document, written in German in a 15th/16th-c.-type cursive bookhand/chancery
  hand (observation of script only; no date inferred). Long lines run the full
  width; no columns, rubrics, running titles, glosses or ruling seen. Text is
  continuous prose with virgules (/) as punctuation and occasional enlarged
  capitals (e.g. "Den", "Vnd", "Als", "So").
- The strips were cut into a comb shape: a continuous left (or right) spine with
  four projecting tabs, separated by cut-away gaps. Text on the tabs continues
  the lines of the spine; in the gaps, line-ends are lost. This looks like reuse
  as binding strips (interpretation).
- 1r and 2r carry dense text (about 60+ lines each). 1v and 2v are largely
  blank with show-through, plus: on 1v a short dorsal note of 5-6 lines
  written upside down relative to the overview (image-019/020/022), and on
  1v and 2v mirror-image offset text on one tab (image-017, image-041) - text
  transferred from another written surface, readable when flipped.
- Content (from what is read): a German charter / sale instrument issued by a
  "Gotzhaus" (abbey) of the Cistercian order ("des Ordens von Citel") selling
  grain rent (Roggen, "malter") from its great corn tithe at a place spelled
  "Küttrißhausen / kättrishausen", to Hans Vehlin (Vetlin?) and Anthoni Welser
  (?), with warranty, damage and distraint clauses, sealing and dating clause.
  These are readings of names on the leaf, not an identification.

TRANSCRIPTION
-------------
Conventions: line numbers count from top of the named image; ' = superscript
mark / abbreviation stroke; (..) = proposed expansion; ? after a doubtful word;
[illegible] = unread. Line beginnings/ends cut by the strip edge or by the comb
gaps are marked with "|". Overlapping tiles repeat lines; I give each line once
and name the tile where it is clearest.

=== FACE 226-2r (overview image-023; tiles 024-033) ===

Top block (spine + tab 1), image-024 (left) + image-025 (right, same lines):
024/025 L1  |ren vnd veriehen offenlich fur vns das yetzge[...]t vns' (vnser)
            Gotzhauß vnd|
024/025 L2  |vnd zeitig vorbetrachtung in vnserm versamleten (?) beleuten (?)
            Capitel/ als|
024/025 L3  |it wir vns' vnd vnsers Gotzhauß wachsenden schaden furkomen vnd|
024/025 L4  |sach yetz vnd hernach an allen Stetten vnd vor allen lewten [?]
            ge|
024/025 L5  |chen / Den Ersamen vnd weysen Hansen Vehlin vnd Anthonien|
024/025 L6  |guldin gemainer landswerung die Sy vns bar (?)/ als nemblich der|
024/025 L7  |vnsern vnd des vorgenanten vns' Gotzhauß [illegible] nutz vnd
            fromen an|
  (tab 1 ends here at right; next lines are spine only)
024 L8      |d redlich verkaufft vnd zu kauffen gegebe[n]|
024 L9      |mit ainand' (?) funfftzig mal' (malter) Roggens [?]|
024 L10     |beraitt zegeben vnd zenemen sey / kauffm[...]|
Notes: L6 "bar" is uncertain (could be "ewig"/"[...]barh"); L2 "versamleten"
reading of "verſamleten" uncertain, the word after it may be "beleuten" or
"geleuten".

Middle block (spine + tab 2), image-026 (left) + image-027 (right):
026 L1      [top line cut: |...]
026 L2      |d redlich verkaufft vnd zu kauffen gegebe[n]|  (= 024 L8)
026 L3      |mit amand' (?) funfftzig mal' Roggens [..]|  (= 024 L9)
026 L4      |beraitt zegeben vnd zenemen sey / kauffm[...]|
026/027 L5  |schausen (?) in Augspurg' Bistumb an der Guntz gelegn / Vnd
            ausser alle|
026/027 L6  |m gehörn sol oder mag gantz nichtz außgenome der in auch darumb|
026/027 L7  |krafft diz brieffs vor meniglich haissen vnd sein sol fur ledig
            richtig|
026/027 L8  |daselbs zu küttrißhausen sein zimliche vnd auffgesetzte prouision
            daruon|
026/027 L9  |ch wol wir noch vns' nachkomen furohin vber das kain endrung thun|
026/027 L10 |nhaiden (?) Vehlin auch burg zu chemingen (?)/ auß dem bemelden
            vnsern|
026/027 L11 |en vnd verhaissen versprechen vnd verhaissen auch yetz wissentlich in|
026/027 L12 |ß zehend / mit seinen frúchten nútzen rechten vnd zugehörungen
            ymm[er]|
026/027 L13 |s Roggens Als nemlich yedem insond' (insonder) funffvndzwaintzig
            mal' (malter) wie|
026/027 L14 |r tag vnd Weihennächten / oder ob ye das korn zu küttrißhausen
            durch|
026/027 L15 |r aber wan wir das in sölich gutte vn' vergleichung nit su (?) in
            noch|
026/027 L16 |Martins tag vnd Weyhennächten nach gemain[...]|
026 L17     |wern vnd zu iren sichern handen [...]|
026 L18     |vnd weltlich lewte vnd gerichte / Vnd [...]|
Notes: L10 opening ("nhaiden"? "Bernharden"?) uncertain; "chemingen" may be
"Uemingen"/"Geuningen" - uncertain. L15 "vergleichung" doubtful.

Middle block continued (spine + narrow wedge tab), image-028 (left) + image-029
(wedge at left edge of 029):
028 L1      |Martins tag vnd Weyhennächten nach [...]|
028 L2      |wern vnd zu iren sichern handen vn[...]|
028 L3      |vnd weltlich lewte vnd gerichte / Vnd sun[st]|
029 L3      ... gem (?) |
028 L4      |istungn (?) vnd schaden / Wir vnd alle v[ns']| + 029 "vnd alle vns' vn[...]"
028 L5      |ein zugehorung wie obstat ir der obgena[nten]| + 029 "der obgenanten"
028 L6      |vnd ab dem obgeschriben grossen zehenden zu|
028 L7      |n daran rechtlich od' sunst vnd fúrer vnd|
028 L8      |gult recht Nach landsrecht vnd nach dem|
028 L9      |nd iren erben sament vnd sond' die vorbe[nanten]|
028 L10     |d zu der zeit wie hieuor aigentlich vnders[...]|
028 L11     |vnd alle ir helffer gantzn vollen gew[alt]|
028 L12     |ganck hettn / ab schaden zenemen v[...]|
028 L13     |also ye schadens darauff wuchs od[er]|
028 L14     |ichtn pfandung nachraisen versam[...]|
028 L15     |Gotzhauß vnd nachkomen / In vnd ir[...]|
028 L16     |schadn / Vnd Sy habn also den g[...]|
028 L17     |das an schaden od' nit / So habn die|

Lower block (spine + tab 3), image-030 (left) + image-031 (right):
030 L1      |ichtn pfandung nachraisen versam[...]|
030 L2      |Gotzhauß vnd nachkomen / In vnd ir[...]|
030 L3      |schadn / Vnd Sy habn also den g[...]|
030 L4      |das an schaden od' nit / So habn die|
030/031 L5  |gericht vnd one clag od' ob Sy wellen mit gericht gaistlichem od'|
030/031 L6  |n zu küttrißhausen / iren vndpfand oder ob Sy wellen darzu A[..]|
030/031 L7  |vmbzetreiben zu bekumbern zu nemn vnd zu pfenden In Stetten Märckt|
030/031 L8  |ars als offt es zu schulden kombt / es (?) vallen aufstenden zins vnd|
030/031 L9  |oor (?) vnd schaiden ist vß (?) stet / gentzlich gewert bezalt vnd
            vnclagbar|
030/031 L10 |ding gegen menglich / Vnd das auch vns vns' Gotzhauß das ob|
030/031 L11 |/ nicht behelffen freyen frid' Schirmen noch fúrtragn sol noch|
030/031 L12 |gkhait noch gnad / glait burgrecht aynung puntnuß Landtfrid|
030/031 L13 |em behilff fúrzung (?) fund list noch sach gantz vberal in kain weiß|
030/031 L14 |am vzeichen (?) vfahe nicht es sey dan am sundrung (?) vorgegangen|
030/031 L15 |iz brieffs / gegen den benanten Hansen Vehlin vnd Anthoni Welser|
030/031 L16 |n vnd entpfrembdet haben in all weiß vnd [illegible]|
030 L17     |ichten Hansen Vehlins vnd Antho[ni]|
